ios.desc:
You know that feeling. You're watching an amazing movie, your drink kicks in, and you're stuck choosing between missing a key scene or suffering through the rest of the film.

RunPee solves this. We tell you the best times to take a bathroom break during a movie — without missing anything important. RunPee is 100% free and supported entirely by donations from our community — no paywall.

HOW IT WORKS
Before the movie starts, look up your film in RunPee. You'll see a list of Peetimes, each carefully chosen by our expertly trained staff. Peetimes are scenes in a movie, usually 3-4 minutes long, that are easy to summarize without missing anything important, like a dramatic scene, or funny moment, or exciting action. Each Peetime includes:
  • When to go (a cue so you know exactly when it starts)
  • How long the bathroom break lasts
  • A short summary (hidden unless you tap) of what happened, so you don't have to ask anyone, "What did I miss?"

Start the RunPee timer when the movie begins. The app will gently vibrate 30 seconds before each Peetime starts, so you're never caught off guard.

ANYTHING EXTRA AFTER THE CREDITS?
Wondering if there are post-credits scenes worth staying for? RunPee's "Anything Extra" feature tells you — without spoilers — whether there are mid-credit or end-credit scenes after the movie. No more sitting through 10 minutes of credits for nothing.

PEETIMES FOR EVERY NEW RELEASE
Our team watches every major release and hand-picks the best Peetimes. New movies are added weekly. We've covered over 1,900 movies and counting.

DESIGNED FOR THE THEATER
Dark theme, silent vibration alerts, minimal screen brightness. RunPee is designed to be invisible to everyone in the cinema except you.

NOW IN 42 LANGUAGES
Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and many more. Take RunPee to any movie theater in the world.

TRUSTED BY MOVIEGOERS FOR 18+ YEARS
RunPee was created by Dan Gardner, a moviegoer who had one too many badly-timed bathroom breaks. What started as a simple idea in 2008 has grown into the original movie bathroom break app, trusted by hundreds of thousands of movie fans worldwide.

WHY MOVIEGOERS LOVE RUNPEE
  • Never miss the best scenes during a movie
  • Know exactly when to take a bathroom break
  • Find out if there are post-credits scenes — for free
  • Human-curated Peetimes, not AI-generated
  • 100% free and donation supported — no paywall, no subscriptions requi

quotes.text:
I note that the app store reviews[1] mention that it does a lot of forced ad-watching. One says "must sit through a 10 second bright full screen ad for bladder medication upon opening". This seems counterproductive for an app that you may want to glance at during the film, to say the least...

[1]: https://itunes.apple.com/app/id450326239?mt=8
quotes.story_title: RunPee – Because movie theaters don't have pause buttons
